name: Biocalce Zoccolatura
description: Biocalce Zoccolatura is a WTA certified dehumidifying plaster based on NHL 3.5 natural hydraulic lime, made for restoring masonry affected by damp. A dehumidifying plaster is not a waterproofer. It is deliberately porous, so that moisture rising through a wall evaporates within the thickness of the plaster and the salts it carries crystallise inside the pore structure rather than on the finished face. Blocking the damp instead, with a cement render or a tanking coat, only moves it higher up the wall. WTA certification is the German restoration standard for exactly this behaviour. Supplied in 25 kg bags with twelve months of shelf life. It goes over a rough coat and has to be built as a system, because a dehumidifying plaster finished with a dense skim stops working.

name: Rasobuild Eco Consolidante
description: Rasobuild Eco Consolidante is a stabilising agent used to strengthen old and fragmented plaster and render coats before anything is applied over them. It answers the question that decides most renovation jobs, which is whether the existing plaster can be kept or has to come off. A coat that is weak and crumbling at the surface but still sound behind can be consolidated and reused, saving the cost and the mess of hacking off. One that has lost its bond to the masonry cannot, and no consolidant will change that, so hammer test the wall first. Supplied in 5 kg cans with twenty four months of shelf life, the longest in this range. Apply to a clean, dust free surface and let it cure before the levelling coat goes on.

name: Rasobuild Eco Extrafino
description: Rasobuild Eco Extrafino is an eco friendly mineral plaster and render finish, the finest grade in the Rasobuild Eco range as the name indicates. It is a finishing coat rather than a body coat. It goes on thin over a levelled substrate to give the surface its final texture before decoration, and it follows the plane it is given, so the correction has to be done in the layer below it. Being mineral, it stays breathable and compatible with mineral substrates. Pot life is four hours, which is generous and makes it workable for a small gang across a large wall. Supplied in 20 kg bags with twelve months of shelf life. On a hot UAE site that pot life shortens in practice, so keep bags and mixing water out of the sun.

name: Rasobuild Eco Granello
description: Rasobuild Eco Granello is the grained version of the Rasobuild Eco mineral plaster and render finish, which is the practical difference from the fine grades. A textured finish is more forgiving than a smooth one. It breaks up reflected light, so small variations in the coat beneath become far less visible, and on a long external elevation that is often the deciding factor. It remains a mineral finishing coat, breathable and compatible with mineral substrates. Pot life is four hours and shelf life twelve months, supplied in 25 kg bags. Texture depends on how the surface is worked as the material stiffens, so keep one applicator and one technique across an elevation, and agree the finish on a sample panel before the wall is started.

name: Rasobuild Eco Stucco RP
description: Rasobuild Eco Stucco RP is a finishing product, a mineral and organic grout used to close up and smooth a surface rather than to fill tile joints. Kerakoll describes the result as highly flexible with an ultra smooth final finish, and flexibility is what keeps a thin skim from crazing over a substrate that moves slightly. It is supplied in 1 kg buckets with a 12 month shelf life, a pack size that tells you the intended use: making good, filling and finishing localised areas rather than skimming a whole elevation. The eco-friendly label is Kerakoll's own designation, so ask for the current documentation if a project needs it toward a green building credit. Work it in thin passes, because a flexible filler applied too thick in UAE heat skins while the body below is still soft.

name: Rasobuild Eco Top Fino
description: Rasobuild Eco Top Fino is an eco friendly mineral finishing coat, and what sets it apart from the plain finishing grades is its declaration under EN 1504-3, the concrete repair standard. That places it on repaired concrete rather than only on plaster. It is the smooth finishing layer taken over a structural repair mortar to bring a patched face back to one surface before a protective coating goes on. Specifiers working to EN 1504 need every layer in the build up declared, which is what this grade provides. Pot life is four hours and shelf life twelve months, supplied in 25 kg bags. Confirm compatibility with the repair mortar below and the protective coating above, because the three are meant to work together as one system.
